tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po la wa bhu ti pa'i rnam thar bstod pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ra we/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug drin can rdo rings pa chen po la/ yon tan rtogs par brjod pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dngos grub yid bzhin gyi chu gter bzhad pa zhes bya ba/ rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang de nyid la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag kun bzang he ru ka /bka' drin mnyam med mkhas grub chos kyi rje/ /gsang chen bstan pa'i nyi ma rdo rings pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod chos sku bde chen mkha' dbyings nas/ /gzugs sku nyi zla'i snang brnyan bgrang yas sprul/ /skal bar 'tshams pa'i zab yangs 'od 'phreng gis/ /'gro ba'i mun sel mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskal bzang 'di la bde gshegs 'khor ba 'jig /lā ba'i zhabs dang bram ze mchog sred dang / /phag gru pa dang ri phug rnal 'byor sogs/ /rnam 'phrul du mar bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus 'dir byang phyogs kha ba'i sman ljongs kyi/ /gtsang gi rdo rings zhes bya'i grong khyer du/ /yab mchog rgyal rigs ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /sras su bsams bzhin 'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas byis pa'i spyod las 'das/ /srung ma'i zhal gzigs gdug can 'byung po btul/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun e wam̐ pas/ /lung bstan rjes su bzung la gsol ba 'debs/ /padmas lung bstan sprul pa'i rgyal po yis/ /mchog tu bsngags shing khyim pa'i spyod tshul gyis/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams byams pa'i khrims kyis bskyangs/ /chos kyi rgyal po khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi rol snang ba na bun lta bur shar/ /rang rig gdod ma'i mgon po rang zhal gzigs/ /rgyal tshab bla mas bstod bsngags shis brjod mdzad/ /nyams rtogs ye shes 'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dregs ldan 'byung pos zhabs kyi padmar btud/

/mtshan ldan ḍā kis bde chen ye shes bskyed/ /las mgon nag pos dam nyams mgo bo phul/ /grub dbang gzhon nu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'od gsal ngang du rje btsun sa skya pa/ /dkar po rnam gsum zhal gzigs lung bstan thob/ /zhing skyong dbang pos gtor ma dngos su blangs/ /ting 'dzin dbang po khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /dag pa'i rmi lam yul nas mdo khams dang / /rgya hor yul gzigs o rgyan gnas su byon/ /ind+ra bhū ti dang mjal smon lam btab/ /mkha' 'gros gsang rdzas phul la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje gdan du ma hā bo dhi mjal/ /rang gi bla ma mchog dang gsung gleng mdzad/ /mu stegs rnams la rdo char phab snyam tshe/ /slar yang byams pas bskyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gru 'dzin ri bo'i rtse mor spyan ras gzigs/ /zhal mjal rtsa ba'i tsan dan nags tshal du/ /yum mchog sgrol ma tha mal bud med kyi/ /rnam par rol pas gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /stag zhon nag po stag gi gzugs su gzigs/ /dur khrod bdag pos chu bo'i 'jigs las bsgral/ /glo bur 'byon tshe rgyun gtor mkha' ngos 'phar/ /pe har bka' bzhin bsgrubs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen du/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po'i zhabs kyi zla dbang mngon sum mjal/ /lung bstan dges pas bskyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /slar yang sngon gyi yongs 'dzin e wam̐ pas/ /mnal lam ngang du dbu skra nas bzung ste/ /myur bar rab tu byung bar bskul ba'i mthus/ /rgyal srid ring du spangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos grwa chen po dpal ldan grwa thang du/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje/ /shes rab zla ba'i zhabs pad nyer bsten nas/ /rab tu byung bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /grwa yi ri sul dben pa'i nags tshal du/ /rigs byed dbang mos dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal bstan/ /'phral dang yun gyi dngos grub mtshan ma thob/

/nye gnas yi rangs gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan srung rnams kyis dngos dang rmi lam du/ /yang yang bskul nas dpal ldan sa skyar phebs/ /bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs pad bsten/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres la gsol ba 'debs/ /bcu phrag gcig dang zung gi lo yi bar/ /bsten nas mnyes pa gsum gyis gus mchod de/ /so so thar dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rig 'dzin sdom pa nos la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab dang rgya che'i dam chos ji snyed pa/ /khyad par bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /snyan brgyud gcig brgyud gser chos ma lus pa/ /bum pa gang byor gsan la gsol ba 'debs/ /sa bzang dgon par zla ba bco brgyad bar/ /gsung ngag zab mo'i slob bshad rdzogs par zhus/ /snyan brgyud bzhi dang tshad ma rnam pa bzhi/ /rten 'brel mtha' dag 'grig la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan yang mkhas dang grub pa'i yongs 'dzin mchog /bdun cu rtsa gnyis gus pas rab bsten nas/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshig don ma lus pa/ /gsan cing thugs su chud la gsol ba 'debs/ /kha'u brag rdzong bya 'gyur rdo rje'i brag /byang chub rdzong sogs dben pa'i ri khrod du/ /gsang chen rgyud kyi snying po rim pa gnyis/ /rtse gcig nyams len mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtag par thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor lhur len cing / /mnyam rjes rnal 'byor rnam bcu'i nyams len gyis/ /nyams dang rtogs pa ma lus mthar phyin pa'i/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag chen rje yi bka' bsgrub lam zhugs dus/ /srung ma'i tshogs rnams sprin ltar rjes su 'brengs/ /mkhyen rab chos rjes dbang bskur yi rangs mdzad/ /bzhed don phrin las grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /tsha rong gnas su ston gyi sprin dkar ltar/ /gsal ba'i kha sar pā ṇi zhal mjal zhing / /rdo rings bzhugs tshe 'phags pa gtso 'khor gsum/ /'ja' gur dang bcas gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /grub dbang stong gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i nags/

/mkhas pa'i skye bos brten pa'i rdo rje'i spo/ /kha'u brag rdzong nag po'i seng ge'i khrir/ /zhabs sen padmo bkod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma lhar bcas mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /zang zing dngos kun chags med sbyin par gtong / /thun bzhi lhur len grub rigs 'dzin pa brgya/ /'dod dgus tshim par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gsung gi bdud rtsi yis/ /rtsa rlung gegs kyis gdung ba ma lus sel/ /rigs sngags zab mo'i springs yig gad rgyangs kyis/ /bgegs tshogs ring du bskrad la gsol ba 'debs/ /gur gyi mgon po'i gsang khrid bsgoms pa'i tshe/ /'od gsal ngang nas rang rig mgon por gyur/ /e ka dza ṭi sogs kyis mtha' bskor ba'i/ /dag pa'i snang ba thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /nā land+ra ru rjes gnang mdzad pa'i dus/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin nag 'khrigs pa'i klong / /mkha' 'gro lha brgyad sku yi snang brnyan ni/ /me dpung 'bar bar gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs rung cho 'phrul du mas bskul ba las/ /skyed lhas mgon khang steng gi gsang sgo'i dbus/ /zhing skyong dbang po zhal bzhi nam mkha'i mdog /gzi 'od 'bar bar gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /kha'u brag sgor phebs tshe bram ze'i gzugs/ /dkar po 'jigs rung rtse gsum thod khrag can/ /yum bzhir bcas sogs rnam 'phrul du ma ni/ /rtag par gzigs par mdzad pa gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags pa brag phug nang du bram ze ni/ ku ba ku sha thogs pas sku khrus gsol/ /paṇa chen chos rje'i drung du bram gzugs sngo/ /ras sngon gos can gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan 'ga' yis gur mgon dngos su mthong / /dregs ldan du mas bka' bstsal spyi bos nod/ /lkog gyur ma lus gsal bar lung ston pa'i/ /thogs med mngon shes mnga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /shab stod ri bor rdor dril nam mkhar bzhag /rab mkhregs 'dzin mar gtor chen thog ltar thim/

/mdos gtor khrod nas me dpung chen po 'phros/ /sngags 'chang dbang por grags la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhing gyur skye bos rgol bar brtsams pa'i tshe/ /dmigs thun gcig gis rdo rje'i zhing du bsgral/ /'byung po'i ded dpon gdong pa dgu pa yis/ /zhabs kyi padmar 'dud la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' ngos dmar ljang yig 'brus bltams pa dang / /yig drug rang sgra bar snang grags pa sogs/ /dag pa'i nyams kyi rnam rol ji snyed pa/ /rgyun du 'char ba de la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /sa skya'i rje btsun zhal gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /snyan rgyud zab mo'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ /zla med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ de ltar khyod zhabs padma'i ze'u 'bru las/ /gsang chen sbrang rtsi'i bka' drin thob pa yi/ /mkhas grub slob bu'i bung ba bgrang yas kyi/ /gangs can pad mtsho khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhing gzhan 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa na/ /nor 'dzin g.yo zhing sgra 'od dri bzhon ldang / /rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros rin chen khrir btegs nas/ /spyan 'dren rnam 'phrul ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /dad ldan slob bur chos rnams rdzogs par gnang / /'di phyi'i lung bstan skye dang tshe rabs su/ /ltos par bcas pa thams cad rjes 'dzin pa'i/ /zhal bzhes snang ba thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings bsdus pa'i tshe/ /phyogs kun kunda'i 'od chags kha bas bltams/ /'ja' tshon dang bcas me tog char chen babs/ /lha rdzas rol mo 'khrol la gsol ba 'debs/ /slar yang 'od gsal ngang nas skur bzhengs te/ /seng ge'i khri la zhabs sen padma bkod/ /'dzum zhal bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis skal ldan gyi/ /snying gi gdung ba sel la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gdung rin chen las grub a yig dkar/ /hūm̐ yig nag po bam̐ yig li khri'i mdog /zhing skyong dbang po'i sku dang ring bsrel sogs/

/ngo mtshar rten mchog byon la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rtsod dus rdo rje 'chang / /bka' drin 'khor med drin can rdo rings pa/ /yongs su grags pa'i rje btsun gnyis spangs zhabs/ /rnam thar dran zhing snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang bdag la ltos pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /skye dang skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mgon po khyod la snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /re ltos gzhan na med do thugs rjes skyongs/ /lus ngag longs spyod srog gi 'tsho ba'i bar/ /khyod mnyes bgyid pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtshor 'bul/ /bdag gi nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /khyod kyi 'phrin las 'khor los bsgyur bar shog /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub pa'i tshe/ /'khrul snang mun pas cung zad mi sgrib par/ /khyod mgon gang du bzhugs pa'i zhing khams su/ /'dzum zhal mthong nas thugs rjes skyong bar shog /mdor na bdag la 'brel ba thob pa dang / /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba ji snyed pa/ /thams cad mgon po khyod kyis rjes bzung nas/ /thugs yid bde chen dbyings su 'dren par shog /gnas skabs 'dir yang tshe ring nad med cing / /dpal 'byor lung rtogs yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas/ /phyogs rnams kun las rnam par rgyal gyur te/ /rje btsun bla ma'i bstan pa 'dzin par shog /ces drin can rdo rings pa chen po la rnam thar gyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa/ shlo ka lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'di ni/ rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po'i zhabs rdul gtsug gis mchod cing / bka' drin chen pos 'tsho ba'i bka' 'bangs rgyal khams kyi bsod snyoms pa blo gsal rgya mtshos mang mkhar dmu gshongs kyi rang gi bsam gtan khang bur sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang rje bla ma'i bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/
